description: Three computer riders race the player on Gull Cove with the same physics: they follow the racing line through the buoys, and places update live.

steps.name: riding the same craft as the player
after 30 s every computer rider is over 380 m round
passing buoys on their marked sides

steps.expect: [player.place, racers[1].place, racers[2].place, racers[3].place].has(1) and [player.place, racers[1].place, racers[2].place, racers[3].place].has(4)
steps.name: places 1 to 4 are given
the HUD shows the player's place
